300:t_2:131.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So the wind is blowing our way.」

300:t_2:132.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Good... As soon as we're ready, we leave $$ＥＸ－１０$$.」

300:t_2:134.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「If we're talking about getting ready, don't forget this.」

300:t_2:136.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「We had it repaired here. That mask gave us hope of resisting.」

300:t_2:137.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「That's right. The masked man is your selling point, so if you show your face, the bluff won't work.」

300:t_2:139.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Everyone, prepare to depart. From here, we begin fighting again.」

300:t_2:141.en:
$$カレン$$
「Thank you, $$キデーラ$$, $$ポタリア$$. We'll definitely meet again.」

300:t_2:142.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「$$カレン$$... If you see $$エスター$$, give her a message.」

300:t_2:143.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Tell her I'm still carrying on my own fight, even now.」

300:t_2:144.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... I'll be sure to tell her.」

300:t_2:145.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「We're setting out now. This is no time to be teary-eyed.」

300:t_2:146.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「You'll shame the name of the Red Devil, $$カレン$$.」

300:t_2:149.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「Until we meet again, $$キリコ$$.」

300:t_2:150.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Well... I don't think you need worrying about, but don't go and die.」

300:t_2:155.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...I had lost $$フィアナ$$, been separated from my comrades, wounded, and was being hunted by the enemy. Even now, I hadn't lost the will to fight...)

300:t_2:156.en:
$$キリコ$$
(The heat and humidity of $$クメン$$, where I once fought alongside my comrades and was reunited with $$フィアナ$$, were giving me something...)

300:t_2:157.en:
$$キリコ$$
(I don't know where I or the world are headed...)

300:t_2:158.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But the fighting goes on... With that premonition, I start walking again...)

301:t_000:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness... You've been unconscious all this time...」

301:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I tried checking $$ジェニオン$$'s data, and it looks like a lone island in the Pacific.」

301:t_000:7.en:
$n
「The Pacific... Then we got thrown here by that $$時空震動$$...」

301:t_001:0.en:
$n
「...It won't start... Some kind of machine trouble...」

301:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Even if $$ジェニオン$$ did move, where would you go?」

301:t_001:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The rest of $c aren't here either... Do we even have anywhere to go...?」

306:t_000:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Past this jungle is the rendezvous point with Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$.」

306:t_000:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, $$シャッコ$$... I never expected you to be in $$クメン$$, too.」

306:t_000:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ invited me too, but $$ポタリア$$ had also approached me.」

306:t_000:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「But is it really okay? Ending up going with us.」

306:t_000:4.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ポタリア$$ sent me off. He said I'm one of $c, too.」

306:t_000:5.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Besides... there was something I personally wanted to look into.」

306:t_000:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(As expected of the $$クエント$$, who banished those with special powers. So he sensed the aura that is beginning to envelop the world...)

306:t_000:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So there's a $$マーティアル$$ temple here, too...」

306:t_001:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「I hear $$マーティアル$$'s authority collapsed after the assault operation on the holy land of $$アレギウム$$, but it seems they still have a fair amount of power.」

306:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That incident is apparently known to the world as the 《$$赫い霍乱$$》 of $$アレギウム$$.」

306:t_001:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sweet. The guys doing whatever they pleased in the name of God all turned into plain clowns in one stroke.」

306:t_001:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Oops, sorry, $$キリコ$$. I got carried away.」

306:t_001:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't worry about it. It's in the past.」

306:t_001:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(In that battle, $$キリコ$$ lost $$フィアナ$$...)

306:t_001:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, it's a bold plan. Going out of our way to pass right under $$マーティアル$$'s nose.」

306:t_001:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Wouldn't those guys come after us for payback?」

306:t_001:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll simply meet them head-on.」

306:t_001:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「You mean we came here just to fight!?」

306:t_001:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's no need to worry. We have $$キリコ$$, the star of the $$赫い霍乱$$ at $$アレギウム$$.」

306:t_001:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. Having learned just how terrifying that is, they'd never rashly lay a hand on us, is that it?」

306:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What's more, if the $$サイデリアル$$ come, they'll intervene in the battle. That would be an opportunity for us as well.」

306:t_001:16.en:
$$スザク$$
「With our depleted forces, we have no choice but to make use of other organizations' movements.」

306:t_001:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But, hey... The KMF can fly, so they're fine, but there's no way $$ロジャー$$ and the AS group can go to $$メリダ島$$ like this.」

306:t_001:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't possibly ask $$ポタリア$$ and the others to arrange a transport plane for us...」

306:t_001:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'll have to figure that out as we go. First, let's get out of the jungle.」

306:t_001:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...But it seems it won't be that easy.」

306:t_002:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「A black $$アクシオ$$ and an AT with pincers!」

306:t_002:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Found you...! I found you, $c!」

306:t_002:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「No way... $$カン・ユー$$'s hunch was right.」

306:t_002:6.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Ah... For the sake of my pride, I'll say this: what I said earlier was not a joke.」

306:t_002:7.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Hmph... Even that jinx is useful once in a while.」

306:t_002:8.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Contact the main $$アマルガム$$ force. Tell them we've found the target.」

306:t_002:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$カン・ユー$$! You guys are still working for $$アマルガム$$!?」
